How an infrastructure project works

From evaluation to handoff

Review the catalog and request a consultation. I’ll work with you through scoping, testing, rollout, and handoff.

Before you start

Know what you’re planning for

What does the package price include?

The infrastructure range covers deployment, monitoring, backup configuration, documentation, and administrator training. Application modules, migration, hardware, hosting, and optional support are scoped separately. The final quote confirms the deliverables and recurring costs.

Will self-hosting cost less than my subscriptions?

It depends on your workload and the time needed to operate it. The calculator includes setup, hosting, backups, labor, and scheduled replacements. Select the applications you need and enter your actual bills before comparing totals; the sample subscriptions are not a complete replacement design.

Does the HA package guarantee no downtime?

No. High availability requires compatible applications, redundant databases and storage, and tested failover across independent failure domains. Recovery goals and acceptance tests are agreed during scoping.

Can I see an example before requesting a quote?

The portfolio includes the Antalos infrastructure and Emiliany commerce case studies. The operations demo is an interactive simulation; it does not access or change a live customer system.
